current.text: He tore his Achilles and came back much earlier than expected last season. He finished 19th per game in limited minutes and played 35 minutes a night in the playoffs.
He said he played at about 80 to 85% after the Achilles return.
He missed playoff Game 7 with knee inflammation from compensating for the Achilles. It is not chronic and needed no surgery.

Experts are not worried about the Achilles. Their only concern is the Game 7 knee issue, rated at about 1% risk. One expert wants to hear at media day that he is fine. He is expected to arrive fully healthy.
He is not expected to play limited minutes or sit back-to-backs, including the back-to-backs in the fantasy playoff window.
Jaylen Brown is gone. Tatum is the top option and Paul George is the clear number two in Boston.
Experts expect a big usage season, with more usage than last season.
His rim finishing fell from 69 to 60 after the Achilles return.
His FG% should go up, and he should return to his best.
Experts are comfortable taking him at picks 6 to 8 and call that good value. Some would take him as early as pick 5, and an ESPN ADP of 12 is too late.
In an auction mock draft he went for 46 USD. Josh would have paid more than 45 USD but did not want to spend over 40 USD on anyone.
Boston has 16 back-to-backs, tied for the most in the league, and three in the fantasy playoff window.
Boston plays 4-3-4 games in our playoff weeks, one game short of the maximum.
Boston is projected to be a better regular season team than last year, with about 48 wins.

durable.text: Threes and points are league-level strengths. He also gives strong rebounds and assists for a forward.
His turnovers are high for a forward.
Lloyd names blocks, steals and FG% as his weak categories.
He tore his Achilles, and knee inflammation from compensating for it followed.

note: He is a top 8 pick on both sites (Yahoo value 54 USD, ESPN 57 USD), and a recent auction mock had him at 46 USD. That makes 46 to 55 USD a fair range for a round-one forward who gives threes, points, rebounds and assists. He fits punt TO builds best, and his 45.5% FG% on high volume means a team built on him should look for FG% help. Early checks: the knee report from media day, whether his FG% recovers toward the 45 to 47% range, and whether Boston rests him on any of its 16 back-to-backs.
